Specification: This specification models a very simple distributed trace with a single state variable x. The initial state constrains x to be in the integer range 1..10, and the next-state action increments x by 1 on every step. The temporal specification requires Init initially and then always allows only Next or stuttering via [][Next]_vars; it also defines a simple state invariant Inv asserting that x remains less than 20, with no explicit fault model, fairness conditions, or proofs.
